n9766ad3718.headline: Oil prices rise slightly due to sanctions against Venezuela
n9766ad3718.summary: Oil prices increased modestly due to US sanctions targeting Venezuela's oil sector amid the country's political crisis. The sanctions had only a moderate effect on prices of North Sea crude.
n9766ad3718.why: Oil price movements linked to geopolitical events in major oil-producing countries like Venezuela affect global energy markets and commodity prices.
n9766ad3718.why_moved: US sanctions on Venezuela's oil sector reduced supply expectations, causing a moderate rise in oil prices.
